title: limonium minus
intro: Limonium minus, commonly known as Sea Lavender or Sea Pink, is a low-growing, succulent perennial plant native to the coastal areas of Europe and North Africa. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as skin irritations, wounds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Limonium minus include calming and soothing effects, which can help alleviate anxiety and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
